stops.title: Fekuo no
stops.caption: Kuo ketewa biara, ne ne su.
stops.speech: Fekuo kyerɛ kuo ketewa biara: K-Groups, Kharis Express, New Breeds, ne hwan na ɔdi anim ne berɛ a wɔhyia.

stops.title: Yi mu fa su so
stops.caption: Te so ma ɛyɛ deɛ wopɛ.
stops.speech: Nkorabata a ɛwɔ atifi no yiyi mu fa su so, na deɛ ɛsiane no te so ma ɛyɛ asɔre baa baako.

stops.title: Hunu no wɔ mfonini so
stops.caption: Kuo a ɛbɛn ɔmanfoɔ no.
stops.speech: Mfonini no de wɔn si asase so, na ɛbua asɛm no: deɛ ɛbɛn me ne hwan.
